rows.commentary: 3.1: Aamir Kaleem traps Gulbadin Naib, who flashes out and lobs a catch straight into the waiting hands of Muzahir Raza to depart for 21 off 7 balls, punctuated by three sixes.
3.2: Aamir Kaleem flights it up and Sediqullah Pacha launches it majestically sailing over long-off for a maximum.
3.3: Aamir Kaleem tosses it full again and Sediqullah Pacha repeats the medicine, depositing it over long-off into the stands.
3.4: Aamir Kaleem offers width and Sediqullah Pacha violently drills it through deep extra cover for a boundary.
3.5: Dot ball from Aamir Kaleem to Sediqullah Pacha.
3.6: Aamir Kaleem tosses it up, and Sediqullah Pacha unleashes a towering maximum sailing all the way over long-off.
4.1: Shafiq Jan oversteps with a no-ball as Farmanullah Safi punishes the free hit with a colossal strike soaring over long-off for six.
4.1: Farmanullah Safi finds the boundary off Shafiq Jan for four.
4.2: Shafiq Jan targets Farmanullah Safi, who strokes the ball away to deep extra cover to claim a single.
4.3: Shafiq Jan oversteps and Sediqullah Pacha promptly guides the freebie away to the fine leg fence for four.
4.3: Shafiq Jan drifts it too fine again and Sediqullah Pacha punishes it with a massive strike sailing all the way to the fine leg boundary.
4.4: Shafiq Jan keeps it tighter this time as Sediqullah Pacha rotates the strike with a single swept toward deep mid-wicket.
4.5: Farmanullah Safi greets Shafiq Jan by launching a colossal maximum high and handsome over deep mid-wicket.
4.6: No run for Farmanullah Safi off Shafiq Jan.
5.1: Zohaib Amanat comes into the attack and Sediqullah Pacha instantly launches him soaring straight down the ground for six over long-off.
5.2: Zohaib Amanat errs again and Sediqullah Pacha brilliantly ramps it over the keeper's head for another towering six toward third man.
